title: Large Quantum Gravity Fluctuations of BTZ Black Holes
summary: We study the quantum fluctuations of the black hole horizon in three-dimensional Anti-de Sitter (AdS) spacetime. We define a precise protocol to calculate the horizon fluctuations and define a corresponding ``quantum width'' of the horizon. We relate the horizon fluctuations to boundary correlation functions via holography. Working in perturbative quantum gravity, we find that the quantum width is typically of order $(G_\mathrm{N} L_{\mathrm{AdS}}^3 )^{1/4}$, which is parametrically larger than the Planck scale.
